core_obligations: A conditional strong-coding criterion does not provide regular sections for nonsmooth CAT-negative geodesic phase spaces. The authors construct special pre-Markov sections using Busemann levels and prove the required Holder projections and return-time bounds from quantitative geodesic geometry, producing the irreducible strong coding without a smooth Anosov manifold.
